title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) Crop Insurance Operational Guidelines
source: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India
crop: Food crops, Oilseeds, Commercial / Horticultural crops
content: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) provides comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages. Premium Rates payable by Farmers: 1. Kharif Food & Oilseed crops: Maximum 2.0% of Sum Insured, 2. Rabi Food & Oilseed crops: Maximum 1.5% of Sum Insured, 3. Annual Commercial and Horticultural crops: Maximum 5.0% of Sum Insured. The remaining actuarial premium is subsidized equally (50:50) by Central and State Governments (90:10 for North Eastern States). Coverage stages: 1. Prevented Sowing / Planting risk (up to 25% sum insured payable), 2. Standing Crop risk (yield loss due to drought, flood, pests, diseases), 3. Post-Harvest losses (cyclone, unseasonal rains for crops dried in cut-and-spread condition up to 14 days), 4. Localized Calamities (hailstorm, landslide, inundation). Intimation of loss: Farmers must report crop damage within 72 hours through Crop Insurance App, National Crop Insurance Portal (https://pmfby.gov.in), or toll-free helpline 14447. Documents needed: Land possession certificate/ROR, sowing certificate from Village Patwari, Aadhaar, Bank passbook.
